blocks.prompt: 2 (i) Using Binomial theorem find the value of the following to three places of decimals: \(\sqrt{99}\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein calculator ke baghair \(\sqrt{99}\) nikalna hai.
Chaal yeh hai ke 99 ek perfect square 100 ke bilkul qareeb hai. Is liye \(99 = 100(1 - 0.01)\) likh sakte hain, aur chhote number 0.01 ki binomial series bahut jaldi sahi jawab de deti hai.
Find kya karna hai? \(\sqrt{99}\) teen decimal tak.
Plan: 100 bahar nikalna, \(n = \tfrac{1}{2}\) wali series, chand terms jama karna, phir rounding.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sqrt{99}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value teen decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: 99 ko kisi perfect square aur \((1 + y)\) ke product ki shakal mein likhenge jahan \(y\) bahut chhota ho. Phir \((1 + y)^{1/2} = 1 + \tfrac{1}{2}y - \tfrac{1}{8}y^{2} + \tfrac{1}{16}y^{3} + \dots\) lagayenge. \(y\) jitna chhota, utni kam terms se kaam chal jata hai, kyunke har agli term pichli se kahin chhoti hoti hai.

99 ko 100 ke qareeb likhein
\[\sqrt{99} = (100 - 1)^{1/2}\]
\[= 100^{1/2}\left(1 - \dfrac{1}{100}\right)^{1/2}\]
\[= 10(1 - 0.01)^{1/2}\]
Kyun: 100 sab se qareeb wala perfect square hai, aur us ka square root seedha 10 hai. Andar se 100 common liya to 1 ban gaya \(\tfrac{1}{100} = 0.01\).
Dhyan dein: 81 ya 121 jaise door wale squares lene se \(y\) bara ho jata hai aur bahut zyada terms chahiye hoti hain. Hamesha sab se qareeb wala square chunein.

\(y = -0.01\) ke saath expansion
\[(1 - 0.01)^{1/2} = 1 + \dfrac{1}{2}(-0.01)\]
\[- \dfrac{1}{8}(-0.01)^{2} + \dfrac{1}{16}(-0.01)^{3}\]
Kyun: \(n = \tfrac{1}{2}\) ke coefficients \(\tfrac{1}{2}, -\tfrac{1}{8}, \tfrac{1}{16}\) hain. \(|y| = 0.01\) jo 1 se bahut chhota hai, is liye series valid hai aur bahut tezi se chhoti hoti hai.

Har term ki value
\[= 1 - 0.005 - 0.0000125\]
\[- 0.0000000625\]
\[= 0.9949874\dots\]
Kyun: \((-0.01)^{2} = 0.0001\) aur 8 se divide karne par \(0.0000125\); \((-0.01)^{3} = -0.000001\) aur 16 se divide karne par \(-0.0000000625\). Dekhiye har term pichli se sau guna chhoti hai, is liye teesri decimal par in ka asar khatam ho chuka hai.

10 se multiply aur rounding
\[\sqrt{99} \approx 10 \times 0.9949874\]
\[= 9.949874 \approx 9.950\]
Kyun: Teen decimal ke liye chauthi decimal dekhte hain: woh 9 hai (5 ya zyada), is liye teesri decimal ek barhegi. Teesri decimal 9 thi, 9 + 1 = 10, to carry aage jata hai aur 9.949 ban jata hai 9.950.
Dhyan dein: jawab mein aakhri zero (9.950) zaroor likhein; yeh batata hai ke jawab teen decimal tak sahi hai.

Tasdeeq
\[9.95^{2} = 99.0025\]
Kyun: Jawab ka square 99 ke bilkul qareeb hai. Thora sa zyada isliye hai ke humne round up kiya tha. Yani jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Using Binomial theorem find the value of the following to three places of decimals: \((1.03)^{1/3}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan kaam asaan hai: 1.03 pehle hi \(1 + y\) ki shakal mein hai, aur \(y = 0.03\) chhota sa number hai.
Find kya karna hai? 1.03 ka cube root (power \(\tfrac{1}{3}\)) teen decimal tak.
Rule kaunsa? \(n = \tfrac{1}{3}\) wali binomial series.
Plan: coefficients nikalna, values rakhna, itni terms jama karna ke teesri decimal pakki ho jaye, phir rounding.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((1.03)^{1/3}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value teen decimal tak.
Tareeqa: \((1.03)^{1/3} = (1 + 0.03)^{1/3}\) likh kar \(n = \tfrac{1}{3}\), \(y = 0.03\) ke saath series lagayenge. \(|y| = 0.03 < 1\) hai, is liye series valid hai.

\(n = \tfrac{1}{3}\) ke coefficients
\[n = \dfrac{1}{3}\]
\[\dfrac{n(n - 1)}{2!} = \dfrac{\frac{1}{3}(-\frac{2}{3})}{2} = -\dfrac{1}{9}\]
\[\dfrac{n(n - 1)(n - 2)}{3!} = \dfrac{\frac{1}{3}(-\frac{2}{3})(-\frac{5}{3})}{6} = \dfrac{5}{81}\]
Kyun: \(n - 1 = \tfrac{1}{3} - 1 = -\tfrac{2}{3}\) aur \(n - 2 = -\tfrac{5}{3}\). Teesri coefficient mein ek minus hai (negative), chauthi mein do minus (positive). \(\tfrac{10}{27}\) ko 6 se divide kiya to \(\tfrac{10}{162}\), aur 2 se chhota kiya to \(\tfrac{5}{81}\).

\(y = 0.03\) rakhein
\[(1.03)^{1/3} = 1 + \dfrac{1}{3}(0.03)\]
\[- \dfrac{1}{9}(0.0009) + \dfrac{5}{81}(0.000027)\]
\[= 1 + 0.01 - 0.0001 + 0.0000017\]
Kyun: \(0.03^{2} = 0.0009\) aur \(0.03^{3} = 0.000027\). Phir \(\tfrac{0.03}{3} = 0.01\), \(\tfrac{0.0009}{9} = 0.0001\). Chauthi term sirf \(0.0000017\) hai; teesri decimal par is ka koi asar nahi, is liye aage ki terms ki zaroorat nahi.
Dhyan dein: decimals ka square karte waqt zeros ginein: \(0.03^{2}\) mein chaar decimal places hain (0.0009), do nahi.

Jama aur rounding
\[= 1.0099017\dots \approx 1.010\]
Kyun: Chauthi decimal 9 hai, is liye teesri decimal barhegi. 1.009 mein 9 + 1 = 10, carry aage gaya aur jawab 1.010 bana.

Tasdeeq
\[1.01^{3} = 1.030301\]
Kyun: Jawab ka cube 1.03 ke bahut qareeb hai, to jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Using Binomial theorem find the value of the following to three places of decimals: \(\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{252}}\)
blocks.explanation:
Pehle shakal badalte hain: \(\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{252}} = 252^{-1/5}\), yani fifth root (paanchwan root) aur 1 upar hone ki wajah se negative power.
Ab aisa number chahiye jis ki fifth power 252 ke qareeb ho: \(3^{5} = 243\). Aur \(252 = 243 + 9 = 243(1 + \tfrac{1}{27})\).
Find kya karna hai? Value teen decimal tak.
Plan: 243 bahar, \(n = -\tfrac{1}{5}\) ki series, 3 se divide, rounding.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{\sqrt[5]{252}}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value teen decimal tak.
Tareeqa: Expression ko power ki shakal mein likhenge, phir sab se qareeb wali fifth power (243) bahar nikalenge taa ke bracket \(1 + y\) ban jaye aur \(y\) chhota ho. Phir \(n = -\tfrac{1}{5}\) ke saath series lagayenge.

Power ki shakal aur 243 bahar
\[\dfrac{1}{\sqrt[5]{252}} = 252^{-1/5}\]
\[= 243^{-1/5}\left(1 + \dfrac{9}{243}\right)^{-1/5}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{3}\left(1 + \dfrac{1}{27}\right)^{-1/5}\]
Kyun: Fifth root ka matlab power \(\tfrac{1}{5}\), aur neeche se upar laane par minus: \(-\tfrac{1}{5}\). Kyunke \(243 = 3^{5}\) hai, is liye \(243^{-1/5} = 3^{-1} = \tfrac{1}{3}\). Aur \(\tfrac{9}{243}\) ko 9 se chhota karne par \(\tfrac{1}{27}\).
Dhyan dein: \(2^{5} = 32\), \(3^{5} = 243\), \(4^{5} = 1024\). Fifth powers yaad hon to sahi number foran mil jata hai.

\(n = -\tfrac{1}{5}\) ke coefficients
\[n = -\dfrac{1}{5}\]
\[\dfrac{n(n - 1)}{2!} = \dfrac{(-\frac{1}{5})(-\frac{6}{5})}{2} = \dfrac{3}{25}\]
\[\dfrac{n(n - 1)(n - 2)}{3!} = \dfrac{(-\frac{1}{5})(-\frac{6}{5})(-\frac{11}{5})}{6}\]
\[= -\dfrac{11}{125}\]
Kyun: \(n - 1 = -\tfrac{1}{5} - \tfrac{5}{5} = -\tfrac{6}{5}\) aur \(n - 2 = -\tfrac{11}{5}\). Do minus ka product plus (\(\tfrac{6}{25} \div 2 = \tfrac{3}{25}\)), teen minus ka product minus (\(\tfrac{66}{125} \div 6 = \tfrac{11}{125}\)).

\(y = \tfrac{1}{27}\) rakhein
\[1 - \dfrac{1}{135} + \dfrac{3}{18225} - \dfrac{11}{2460375}\]
\[= 1 - 0.0074074 + 0.0001646\]
\[- 0.0000045 = 0.9927527\]
Kyun: Har coefficient ko \(y\) ki power se multiply kiya: \(\tfrac{1}{5} \cdot \tfrac{1}{27} = \tfrac{1}{135}\), \(\tfrac{3}{25} \cdot \tfrac{1}{729} = \tfrac{3}{18225}\), \(\tfrac{11}{125} \cdot \tfrac{1}{19683} = \tfrac{11}{2460375}\). Phir decimals mein badal kar jama kiya. Chauthi term itni chhoti hai ke jawab par asar nahi dalti, lekin ehtiyat ke liye shamil kar li.

3 se divide aur rounding
\[\dfrac{0.9927527}{3} = 0.3309176 \approx 0.331\]
Kyun: Bahar wala \(\tfrac{1}{3}\) yaad rakhna zaroori hai. Chauthi decimal 9 hai, is liye 0.330 round ho kar 0.331 ban gaya.
Dhyan dein: aakhir mein \(\tfrac{1}{3}\) se multiply karna bhool jana is sawal ki sab se aam ghalti hai; tab jawab 0.993 aa jata hai jo bilkul ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[0.331^{5} \times 252 \approx 1.0012\]
Kyun: Agar \(0.331 = 252^{-1/5}\) hai to \(0.331^{5} \times 252\) lagbhag 1 hona chahiye, aur aisa hi hai. Chhota sa farq round up ki wajah se hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iv) Using Binomial theorem find the value of the following to three places of decimals: \(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{8}}\)
blocks.explanation:
Do square roots ka division ek hi root mein aa jata hai: \(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{8}} = \sqrt{\tfrac{7}{8}}\). Aur \(\tfrac{7}{8} = 1 - \tfrac{1}{8}\), yani shakal pehle hi \((1 + y)^{n}\) wali hai.
Lekin \(y = -\tfrac{1}{8} = -0.125\) itna chhota nahi, is liye zyada terms leni paregi.
Find kya karna hai? Value teen decimal tak.
Plan: \(n = \tfrac{1}{2}\) ki series, chaar terms, agli term ka size dekhna, rounding.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{8}}\).
Humein find karna hai: is ki value teen decimal tak.
Tareeqa: Dono roots ko ek root mein jor kar \((1 + y)^{1/2}\) banayenge jahan \(y = -\tfrac{1}{8}\), phir \(1 + \tfrac{1}{2}y - \tfrac{1}{8}y^{2} + \tfrac{1}{16}y^{3} + \dots\) lagayenge.

Ek root banayein
\[\dfrac{\sqrt{7}}{\sqrt{8}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{7}{8}}\]
\[= \left(1 - \dfrac{1}{8}\right)^{1/2}\]
Kyun: Qanoon \(\tfrac{\sqrt{a}}{\sqrt{b}} = \sqrt{\tfrac{a}{b}}\). Phir \(\tfrac{7}{8}\) ko \(\tfrac{8}{8} - \tfrac{1}{8} = 1 - \tfrac{1}{8}\) likha, taa ke 1 + chhota number wali shakal mil jaye.

Jama karein
\[= 0.9354248\]
Kyun: Chaaron terms jama kar di.

Kya itni terms kaafi hain?
\[\text{next term} = -\dfrac{5}{128}y^{4} \approx -0.0000095\]
Kyun: Yeh is sawal ka sab se zaroori sabaq hai. Agar sirf teen terms leten to jama 0.93555 aata, jo round ho kar 0.936 ban jata, aur yeh ghalat hai. Chauthi term ne jawab ko 0.93542 kar diya. Paanchwi term sirf paanchwi decimal ko chhoti hai, is liye ab jawab pakka hai.
Dhyan dein: jab \(y\) bahut chhota na ho (jaise 0.125), to tab tak terms jama karte rahein jab tak agli term teesri decimal par asar dalna band na kar de.

Rounding
\[0.9354248 \approx 0.935\]
Kyun: Chauthi decimal 4 hai (5 se kam), is liye teesri decimal 5 hi rahegi.

Tasdeeq
\[0.935^{2} = 0.874225\]
\[\dfrac{7}{8} = 0.875\]
Kyun: Jawab ka square \(\tfrac{7}{8}\) ke bahut qareeb hai. Asal value 0.935414... hai, jo teen decimal tak 0.935 hi hai.
